Descriptions.DescriptionText: Welcome to Nasdara Vanilla+. This is a PvE server. Please keep encounters with other players friendly: no shooting on sight or non-consensual player kills.
The core survival experience and map loot remain close to vanilla DayZ. A few rare weapons and equipment items from SNAFU Weapons and MMG have been added to the loot economy.
Armed AI roam parts of Nasdara and may look like other players at a distance. Stay alert when approaching an unknown survivor.
AI can also guard helicopter wrecks. Bring weapons, ammunition, and medical supplies before investigating a crash site.

Approximately every one to two hours, a hostile aircraft may fly over a player. When you receive an incoming-aircraft warning, take cover and stay out of sight. If the aircraft spots you, it will deploy hostile paratroopers to hunt players in the area.
Green Airborne AI reinforcement flares can be found as loot around the map. Load one into a flare gun and fire it to call a friendly reinforcement aircraft to your location.

The friendly aircraft will fly overhead and deploy friendly AI reinforcements near the location where the flare was fired. Approach the reinforcements and use the Recruit action on them. Once recruited, they will follow you and assist you in combat.
Hide from unrequested hostile aircraft, but remain near your reinforcement flare so you can locate and recruit the friendly troops it calls.
